newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILNIAUS BANK SAYS WILL PAY 1.01 MLN LITAS IN DIVIDENDS.
newsitem.headline: VILNIAUS BANK SAYS WILL PAY 1.01 MLN LITAS IN DIVIDENDS.

text.p: Lithunia's Vilniaus Bank said on Thursday that it would pay dividends of 1.01 million litas.
"The shareholders' meeting of the bank on Thursday agreed that the bank would pay 1.01 million litas in dividends," Ausra Maldeikiene, the bank's press spokesmwoman, told Reuters.
The bank said in a statement that the dividends to be paid amounted to 0.65 litas per share.
The bank last week announced that its net profit for 1996 had risen to 24.4 million litas from 2.9 million litas the previous year.
The bank earlier said that it planned to retain the lion's share of its profit within the insitituion to upgrade its computer network.
The bank also said that in 1996, each share capital litas earned 0.24 litas profit versus 0.07 litas in 1995.

"In 1996, the bank increased its market share to 14.00 percent from 6.8 percent and became the largest private Lithuanian bank with almost 90 percent foreign capital," the statement quoted board chairman Julius Niedvaras as saying.
